title: Letters
wikitext:
Stardew Valley Expanded adds more than 40 new '''letters''' to receive in the mail as of version 1.15. Some of these letters arrive in the mail after specific events are seen. Others will come on random days between years 1 and 4. {{Info|For more information on the original vanilla letters, see: [[Stardew:Letters|Stardew Valley Wiki - Letters]].}} ==SVE NPC Letters== ===[[File:Andy Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Andy===
{{Mail |label= Andy {{Icon|Heart}} +(0.5) |class=default |title=Strawberry Seeds from Andy |text=Heya, [farmer's name]!!
Here's three bags of strawberry seeds. These ought to help you durin' your first season in the valley. Farmers gotta stick together these days.
|Andy |item=[[File:Strawberry Seeds.png|48px|link=Stardew:Strawberry Seeds]] (3) }}
{{Mail |label= Andy {{Icon|heart}} (+3) |class=default |title=Seven-Year Gift |text=[Farmer's name],
Hey, [Farmer's Name],
Learned something funny. You know persimmons? The trees can take ten years to start producing fruit. Anyway, gave me a newfound respect for 'em. I've been baking stuff I forage into 'em. Haven't found a finer snack than that.
|Andy |item={{Overlayimg|Stuffed Persimmon|type=Recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Andy {{Icon|Heart}} +(7) |class=default |title=Joja Cola Raffle |text=Heya, [farmer's name]!!
I got lucky in a raffle and landed myself a lifetime supply of Joja Cola! These'll help keep your energy up while you're working on the farm.
|Andy |item=[[File:Joja Cola.png|48px|link=Stardew:Joja Cola]] (50) }}
{{Mail |label= Andy {{Icon|Heart}} +(10) |class=default |title=Andy's Pictures |text=Hey farmer,
Found something in the midst of organizin' my house. Drop on by and I'll show ya! I think you'll enjoy it.
|Andy }}
{{Mail |label= [[Scarlett]] {{Icon|Heart}} +(0.5) |class=default |title=Paycheck From Andy |text=[Farmer's name],
Enclosed is payment for your work in my cellar. It'll be a fine batch of strawberry jam!
|Andy |item={{Price|1150}} }}
===[[File:Claire Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Claire===
{{Mail |label= Claire {{Icon|Heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= Homemade Is Best |text= Hi!
Frozen Joja meals are so unhealthy, aren't they? I've been trying to eat healthier lately. My neighbor has a nectarine orchard during the summer, and I found an amazing recipe for 'Nectarine Fruit Bread' that I adore! If you grow nectarines, you should try it.
|Claire |item={{Overlayimg|Nectarine Fruit Bread|type=Recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Claire {{Icon|Heart}} +(14) |class= movie |title= Thief Of Justice Movie Invitation |text= You are cordially invited to attend a very special early showing of:
THE THIEF OF JUSTICE
STARRING CLAIRE WHITLEY
Premiering tonight at the theater at 5 PM. }}
===[[File:Gunther Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Gunther===
{{Mail |label= 60 Items Donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]] |class= default |title= Museum Payment |text= Dear [farmer's name],
Enclosed is a portion of the funding we were recently awarded by the Regional Secretary of Artifacts. Thanks to your generous donations, the museum has become a major contributor to ongoing efforts to conserve Ferngill's cultural heritage. I hope these funds provide assistance in your future adventures.
|Gunther |item= {{Price|40000}} }}
{{Mail |label= All Items Donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]] |class= default |title= Galdoran Gem Reward |text= Dear [farmer's name],
Thanks to your generous donations, the museum's collection is now complete. As a way of extending my gratitude, I'm giving you a very special treasure. This gem was excavated in a far away magical land called Galdora. It's yours now.
P.S. It might be worth your while to stick it in a crystalarium!
|Gunther |item= [[File:Galdoran Gem.png|48px|link=Galdoran Gem]] }}
{{Mail |label= Gunther {{Icon|Heart}} (3) |class= default |title= The Simple Things |text= Dear [farmer's name],
I've tried cuisines from all over the world. The Gotoro Empire, the Fern Islands - I've even tried some Dwarvish dishes.
But to me, nothing beats a perfectly fluffy baked potato. Don't skimp on the butter and salt.
|Gunther |item= {{Overlayimg|Baked Potato|type=Recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Gunther {{Icon|heart}} +(6) |class= default |title= Payment From Gunther |text= Dear [farmer's name],
Enclosed is payment for your services. Thank you for aiding in my research and protecting me.
|Gunther |item= {{Price|20000}} }}
===[[File:Henchman Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Henchman===
{{Mail |label= After giving Henchman the [[Stardew:Void Mayonnaise|Void Mayonnaise]] and entering the [[Stardew:Witch's Hut|Witch's Hut]] |class= default |title= A Goblin in Need |text=You...
You took something from my employer's home, causing me to lose my job...
... ... ...
Now I'm homeless. You must help... or else...
... ... ...
Come visit me at the marshlands. I will wait.
|Henchman }}
{{Mail |label= After viewing Henchman's Event #2 in the Forbidden Maze |class= default |title= Dusty Marsh Tonics |text= I forgot about the dozen marsh tonics I stored underneath my floor. Now that I have my job back I don't need them. They may be covered in a thick layer of dust but their effects are still potent!
|Henchman |item= [[File:Marsh Tonic.png|48px|link=]] (12) }}
===[[File:Lance Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Lance===
{{Mail |label= Lance, after viewing part II of his 2-hearts event |class= default |title= Lance's Elixirs |text= Dear [farmer's name],
Enclosed in this crate are 24 life elixirs. The Highlands are teeming with danger around every corner. These will help keep you safe.
|Lance |item= [[File:Life Elixir.png|48px|link=Stardew:Life Elixir]] (24) }}
{{Mail |label= Lance {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= Dessert of Warriors |text= Greetings,
Adventurers must maintain a healthy diet. I try to steer clear of excess carbohydrates, myself.
But when I do have a treat, Pineapple Custard Crepes are my favorite. I hope you enjoy them too - in moderation. With a warrior's resolve.
|Lance |item= {{Overlayimg|Pineapple Custard Crepe|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
===[[File:Magnus Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Magnus===
{{Mail |label= Magnus {{Icon|heart}} +(4) |class= wizard |title= Shrine of Illusions |text= Greetings [farmer's name],
You've proven your trustworthiness. I would like to propose I teach you some basic magic. Visit me in my chambers at your earliest convenience.
|M. Rasmodius }}
{{Mail |label= Magnus {{Icon|heart}} +(10) |class= wizard |title= Magnus' Forest Meeting |text= [Farmer's name],
Meet me in the forest west of my tower at 2:00 PM sharp today. There's something we must discuss. Come alone. }}
===[[File:Marlon Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Marlon===
{{Mail |label= Marlon {{Icon|heart}} (2) |class= default |title= Cherry Bombs From Marlon |text= [Farmer's name],
The mines are dangerous. These cherry bombs will help during your expeditions.
Be careful.
|Marlon |item= [[File:Cherry Bomb.png|48px|link=Stardew:Cherry Bomb]] (5) }}
{{Mail |label= Marlon {{Icon|heart}} (4) |class= default |title= Supplies From Castle Village |text= [Farmer's name],
We received an extra shipment of supplies from Castle Village. I believe you can make good use of these. Good luck.
|Marlon |item= [[File:Cherry Bomb.png|48px|link=Stardew:Cherry Bomb]] (10) }}
{{Mail |label= Marlon {{Icon|heart}} (6) |class= default |title= Bombs From Marlon |text= [Farmer's name], Your assistance in monster eradication has been most helpful to our efforts in protecting the valley. These bombs will help you on your adventures. Stay safe.
|Marlon |item= [[File:Bomb.png|48px|link=Stardew:Bomb]] (10) }}
{{Mail |label= Marlon {{Icon|Heart}} (8) |class= default |title= Castle Village Bombs |text= [Farmer's name],
The guild received another shipment of weapons from Castle Village. These bombs pack a punch. Don't stand too close to them once ignited.
|Marlon |item=[[File:Mega Bomb.png|48px|link=Stardew:Mega Bomb]] (10) }}
{{Mail |label= Marlon {{Icon|heart}} (10) |class= default |title= Castle Village Elixirs |text= [Farmer's name],
Camilla, the witch of Castle Village, supplied 30 elixirs to the guild. This is one of her finest brews yet. I'm mailing you half of them. These will assist in your expeditions. Good luck.
|Marlon |item= [[File:Life Elixir.png|48px|link=Stardew:Life Elixir]] (15) }}
===[[File:Martin Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Martin===
{{Mail |label= Martin {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= Better When Fresh |text= Hey!
I was eating lunch at work the other day, and I thought maybe you'd like my mom's recipe!
She always makes me a grilled cheese sandwich to bring to work. Somehow, it always stays perfectly crispy!
|Martin |item= {{Overlayimg|Grilled Cheese Sandwich|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
===[[File:Morgan Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Morgan===
{{Mail |label= Morgan {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= A Taste of Home |text= Hi, [Farmer's name]!
Sometimes when I feel a little homesick, I make my mom's specialty - glazed pears. I thought you would enjoy trying some too. It's really nice after a long day of studying, or farming, I guess. Give it a shot and see!
|Morgan |item= {{Overlayimg|Glazed Pear|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
===[[File:Morris Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Morris===
{{Mail |label= After completion of the Joja Community Development Form |class= joja |title= Joja's Year-Round Seeds |text= Dear valued customer,
Thanks to the warehouse completion, JojaMart is now selling all seeds year-round! We at Joja appreciate your business.|Morris }}
===[[File:Olivia Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Olivia===
{{Mail |label= Olivia {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= A Mother's Recipe |text= [Farmer's name], darling,
Home has been on my mind lately. You know, far-away home. I wanted to share a recipe with you that's near and dear to my heart.
My mother always made these when I needed a pick-me-up. I hope they can do the same for you.
|Olivia |item= {{Overlayimg|Fish Dumpling|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Olivia {{Icon|heart}} +(6) |class= default |title= A Hard Conversation |text= Dear [Farmer's name],
I wanted to thank you for being such a sweetheart and listening to me the other day. I know I can get a little maudlin when I've had a few glasses. Next time we have a drink, I'll tell you about some of the marvelous places I've visited. It's easy to forget there's a world outside of the valley sometimes, but I have plenty of stories to share.
|All my love, Olivia }}
{{Mail |label= Olivia {{Icon|heart}} +(8) |class= default |title= Wine From Olivia |text= Dear [Farmer's name],
The market went my way and I cashed out some of my shares for a huge windfall! To celebrate, I ordered a case of my favorite wine, and I wanted to share a few bottles with you. Let's have a glass together soon!
|Olivia |item= [[File:Wine.png|48px|link=Stardew:Wine]] (5) }}
{{Mail |label= Olivia {{Icon|heart}} +(10), before house party event |class= default |title= Second Feelings |text= Dear [Farmer's name],
I've been having feelings about our relationship we just started. I need to tell you some things. Can you visit me at my residence when you have a chance?
|Olivia }}
{{Mail |label= Olivia {{Icon|heart}} +(10) |class= default |title= Olivia's House Party |text= Hi honey,
I'm throwing a house party tonight at my residence. Most of the townsfolk will be there, along with my special guest: the governor!! I would absolutely love you to come, [Farmer's name]. The party starts at 6:00PM. Don't be late!
|Your love, Olivia }}
===[[File:Scarlett Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Scarlett===
{{Mail |label= Scarlett {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= Cheese Overload |text= Hi, [Farmer's name]!
You know what's better than goat cheese? A whole bunch of goat cheese and then some!
Here's a list of all my favorite types and how to organize them on a board. It's a great snack to share with friends, or someone special!
|Scarlett |item= {{Overlayimg|Cheese Charcuterie|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
===[[File:Sophia Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Sophia===
{{Mail |label= Sophia {{Icon|heart}} +(7) |class= default |title= Sophia's Gift |text= Hey you,
Thanks for helping me restore my parents' room. I couldn't have done it without you, especially with the heavy stuff! I know it's strange I packed everything up and moved it all back... I suppose it was a change of heart.
Enclosed is a bottle of my finest aged Blue Moon wine. Thank you!|Sophia |item= [[File:Aged Blue Moon Wine.png|48px|link=Aged Blue Moon Wine]] }}
===[[File:Susan Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Susan===
{{Mail |label= Introduction |class= default |title= Susan's Introduction |text= Hello, [Farmer's name]
My name is Susan. Lewis told me you're a new farmer in town. I'm trapped on my farm in the mountains so I can't say hi in person! Hopefully the mess Joja made will be cleared out soon, because I'm going a little stir crazy. Can't wait to meet you and see how the farm is shaping up!
|Susan }}
{{Mail |label= Susan {{Season|Summer}} |class= default |title= Susan's Melons |text= [Farmer's name]!
My melons are growing like wildfire this year! Here's some extra seeds I got when I popped a number of them in my seedmaker. Don't go trying to compete with me for the melon market though... I'll win!
|Susan |item=[[File:Melon Seeds.png|48px|link=Stardew:Melon Seeds]] (5) }}
{{Mail |label= Susan {{Icon|heart}} +(3), {{Season|Winter}} |class= default |title= Sweet Winter Friends |text= [Farmer's name],
Hello, dear! I hope you're keeping well this winter. I've finally perfected my recipe for gingerbread men. These sweet little fellows will keep you tasty company during the winter evenings.
And when you bake them, your whole house will smell amazing!
|Susan |item= {{Overlayimg|Gingerbread Man|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Susan {{Icon|heart}} +(6) |class= default |title= Susan's Fertilizer |text= Hello [Farmer's name]!
This is some of the best fertilizer I've made. Grow something delicious and share it with me!
|Susan |item= [[File:Quality Fertilizer.png|48px|link=Stardew:Quality Fertilizer]] (20) }}
===[[File:Victor Portrait.png|80px|link=]] Victor===
{{Mail |label= Victor {{Icon|heart}} +(3) |class= default |title= Oodles of Noodles |text= Hey there, [Farmer's name],
I was going through my library and dug up an old family recipe for one of my favorites - Ramen! Bet you didn't know that spaghetti isn't the only kind of noodles I enjoy!
See? Even I can surprise you sometimes!
|Victor |item= {{Overlayimg|Ramen|type=recipe|width=48|center=true}} }}
{{Mail |label= Victor {{Icon|heart}} +(4) |class= default |title= Dewey |text= Dear [Farmer's name],
I'm writing to thank you for listening to me in the graveyard. I know conversations like that can be stressful. If Dewey ever returns, I know he'll be just as happy to have you for a friend as I am.
|Sincerely, Victor }}
==Vanilla NPC Letters== ===Gus=== {{Mail| |label= Gus {{Icon|Heart}} (2) '''When Mature Events toggled ON only''' |class= default |title= Be Discreet |text= Hi [Farmer's name],
Just wanted to drop you a quick line to ask you not to mention what I told you to Sophia. I trust you to be discreet. It's important we're on the same page. Looking forward to seeing you at the saloon soon.
|Gus }} {{Mail |label= Sophia {{Icon|heart}} (6) |class= default |title= Grampleton Orange Chicken |text= Hey [Farmer's name],
I dug up an old recipe that's now featured on the saloon menu... Grampleton orange chicken! The sweet, tangy, and spiced sauce I make for this dish can cheer up anyone feeling down. Drop by the saloon soon to try it out!
|Gus }} ===Harvey=== ''This isn't a new letter but a change to the vanilla letter.''{{Mail |label= Harvey {{Icon|Heart}} (10) |class= default |title= Harvey's Surprise |text= [Farmer's name],
I have a surprise for you. Meet me in Grampleton Fields, across Shearwater Bridge!|Harvey }} ===Jas=== {{Mail |label= Jas {{Icon|Heart}} (2), after finding her lost in [[Forest West]] |class= default |title= Jas' Thank You Letter |text= To Farmer [Farmer's name],
Aunt Marnie said I needed to write a thank you letter. So... thanks for finding me in the forest and taking me back home. I won't go that far in the forest again.
|Jas }} ===Joja Co.=== {{Mail |label= Day 5 in-game |class= joja |title= Rock Slide Notice |text= To our valued JojaMart customers:
Please be advised that the landslide blockage near the railroad will be cleared using explosives tomorrow morning. Avoid the area in case of falling rocks. Joja Co. is not responsible for any damage incurred to people or property in the vicinity.
|JojaMart: We Value Your Business }} {{Mail |label= Day 29 in-game |class= joja |title= A Charitable Partner |text= Dear resident:
In our time in STARDEW VALLEY, Joja has made an effort to become a contributing member of the community. But we can't do it without your help! If you choose to shop at Joja competitors such as PIERRE'S GENERAL STORE, you won't have the same assurance of quality and consistency. And without your business, we won't be able to afford to contribute as much as we'd like to local charities.

Shop at JojaMart and help keep your community great!
|JojaMart: We Value Your Business }} ===Lewis=== ''This isn't a new letter but a change to the vanilla letter.'' {{Mail |label= {{Season|Winter}} 7 |class= default |title= Festival of Ice Invitation |text= Dear [Farmer's name],
Tomorrow we're all gathering by Andy's house and walking to the fishing spot in the forest for the Festival of Ice.
It's a celebration of winter... there'll be snowmen, ice sculptures, and an ice fishing competition! Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to participate.
|Mayor Lewis }} ===Mr. Qi=== {{Mail |label= After earning {{Price|10000000}} |class= bank |title= Golden Piggy Bank |text= Here's a gift to commemorate you earning 10,000,000g! Keep up the good work, kid. You have a bright future ahead.
|Mr. Qi |item= [[File:Golden Piggy Bank.png|48px|link=Golden Piggy Bank]] }} ===Pierre=== {{Mail |label= Pierre {{Icon|heart}} +(6) |class= default |title= Business is Booming |text= [Farmer's name],
Thanks to you and the quality produce you've been shipping, my store's business is booming. Along with our regular rebates, I wanted to send you a special bonus. Thanks for being such a good customer and contributor to our small community. It's people like you who keep local businesses alive.
|Pierre |item= {{Price|2000}} – {{Price|5000}} }} ===Robin=== ''This isn't a new letter but a change to the vanilla letter.''{{Mail |label= {{NameSDV|Foraging|3|alt=Foraging|alt2=Foraging Skill}} |class= default |title= Robin's Kitchen Letter |text= Dear Farmer [Farmer's name],
You might need some more space someday! That's where I can help. If you bring me some raw materials and pay a fee, I can expand your house. The first expansion I offer includes a kitchen. With a kitchen, you'll be able to cook any recipes you've learned!
Anyway, I hope you're starting to feel at home in Stardew Valley!
|Your local carpenter, Robin }} ==History== * v.1.12: Advertisements 1, 3, 4, 5, and 6 were removed from the game. [[Category:Content]]
